version.changelog: 补全中文文档，更新目录结构

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward Dataify task submitter, but it will use your Dataify token and send Facebook profile URLs to Dataify.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and implementation align: it submits Dataify Builder jobs for Facebook profile URLs, validates the URL prefix, posts to a single Dataify Builder endpoint, and returns task status.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The invocation text is somewhat broad and implicit invocation is enabled, but the workflow tells the agent to show parameters and ask before submitting the task.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown docs, YAML agent metadata, SVG icons, and one Python helper with no installer, dependency install step, background service, or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of DATAIFY_API_TOKEN and outbound HTTPS to Dataify are expected for this integration; the profile URLs and task metadata are sent to Dataify under the user's account.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not silently persist secrets or create background persistence; it suggests environment-variable storage only after asking the user to save the token.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to submit Dataify Facebook profile collection tasks. Check the target Facebook URL before approving submission, understand that Dataify may bill or process the job under your account, and store DATAIFY_API_TOKEN like any other API credential.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Environment-token use and network submission are disclosed and necessary for the Dataify Builder workflow, though explicit permission metadata would improve transparency.
[SQP-1] expected: The Chinese description uses broad scraping/collection phrasing, but it remains focused on Facebook personal profile URL tasks and the workflow requires parameter review before submission.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Implicit invocation is not required for the core function and can increase accidental activation risk, but the default prompt and instructions are still tied to this specific Dataify Facebook profile task.
[EA2] expected: Reusing DATAIFY_API_TOKEN from the environment is normal for API tooling; the artifacts do not silently save tokens and the task parameters are shown before submission.
